title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringing on Intellectual Property Rights

articles.content_en:
Article 2 Where a person sells goods that he knowingly knows bear a counterfeit registered trademark, and the sales amount is not less than 50,000 yuan, it shall be considered as "a relatively large amount" under Article 214 of the Criminal Law, and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or shall be fined.
Where the sales amount is not less than 250,000 yuan, it shall be considered as "a huge amount" under Article 214 of the Criminal Law, and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.

Article 6 Where, for the purpose of profit, a person commits the act specified in Article 218 of the Criminal Law, and the illegal gains are not less than 100,000 yuan, it shall be considered as "a huge amount of illegal gains", and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or shall be fined for the crime of selling infringing reproductions.

Article 7 Where a person commits any of the acts specified in Article 219 of the Criminal Law, and causes losses to the owner of a trade secret in an amount of not less than 500,000 yuan, it shall be considered as "causing significant losses to the owner of a trade secret", and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or shall be fined for the crime of infringing trade secrets.
Where the losses caused to the owner of a trade secret are not less than 2,500,000 yuan, it shall be considered as "causing particularly serious consequences" under Article 219 of the Criminal Law, and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.

Article 8 The "identical trademark" as provided in Article 213 of the Criminal Law refers to a trademark that is completely identical to the counterfeited registered trademark, or that is visually basically indistinguishable from the counterfeited registered trademark and is sufficient to mislead the public.
The "use" as provided in Article 213 of the Criminal Law refers to the act of applying a registered trademark or a counterfeit registered trademark to goods, goods packaging or containers, product manuals, or commercial transaction documents, or using a registered trademark or a counterfeit registered trademark in advertising, exhibitions, or other commercial activities.

Article 11 The circumstance of directly or indirectly collecting fees through ways such as publishing paid advertisements shall fall under the "for the purpose of profit" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law.
The "without permission of the copyright owner" as provided in Article 217 of the Criminal Law refers to circumstances where the actor has not obtained authorization from the copyright owner, or has forged or altered the copyright owner's authorization license, or has exceeded the scope of authorization.
The act of communicating to the public through an information network the written works, music, films, television programs, video recordings, computer software, or other works of others shall be deemed as "reproduction and distribution" under Article 217 of the Criminal Law.

Article 12 The "illegal business turnover" as used in this Interpretation refers to the value of infringing products manufactured, stored, transported, or sold by the actor in the course of committing an act of infringement of intellectual property rights. The value of infringing products that have been sold shall be calculated based on the actual sales price. The value of infringing products that have been manufactured, stored, transported, or not yet sold shall be calculated based on the marked price or the average actual sales price of the infringing products that have been ascertained. If the infringing products have no marked price or the actual sales price cannot be ascertained, the calculation shall be based on the average market price of the infringed products.
Where the infringement of intellectual property rights is committed multiple times and has not been subject to administrative or criminal punishment, the illegal business turnover, the amount of illegal gains, or the sales amount shall be accumulated.
The "piece" as specified in Article 3 of this Interpretation refers to one unit of an identification bearing a complete trademark pattern.

Article 13 Where a person commits the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark under Article 213 of the Criminal Law and also sells the goods bearing that counterfeit registered trademark, and such act constitutes a crime, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 213 of the Criminal Law for the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark.
Where a person commits the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark under Article 213 of the Criminal Law and also sells goods that he knowingly knows bear a counterfeit registered trademark of another person, and such acts constitute crimes, he shall be subjected to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes.

Article 14 Where a person commits the crime of copyright infringement under Article 217 of the Criminal Law and also sells the infringing reproductions, and such act constitutes a crime, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 217 of the Criminal Law for the crime of copyright infringement.
Where a person commits the crime of copyright infringement under Article 217 of the Criminal Law and also sells infringing reproductions that he knowingly knows belong to another person, and such acts constitute crimes, he shall be subjected to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes.

Article 15 Where a unit commits the acts specified in Articles 213 through 219 of the Criminal Law, it shall be convicted and sentenced according to three times the standards for conviction and sentencing of the corresponding crimes committed by individuals as specified in this Interpretation.

Article 16 Where a person knowingly provides loans, funds, bank accounts, invoices, certificates, licenses, or provides convenient conditions or assistance such as production or business premises, or transportation, storage, or agency for import or export, to another person who commits a crime of infringing intellectual property rights, he shall be deemed as an accomplice to the crime of infringing intellectual property rights and punished accordingly.

Article 17 Where any previously issued judicial interpretation concerning crimes of infringing intellectual property rights contradicts this Interpretation, it shall cease to apply after this Interpretation comes into force.
